measurement.inventory: All canonical Allah-family tokens on each selected recto. First/last canonical token boundaries must be explicit, including partial boundary verses. Exclude head basmalas, marginal notes and catchwords. Retain unresolved identities.
measurement.center: Manual whole-token baseline-connected letter-body interval midpoint on 1000px-wide raw scan sheets, detached marks excluded, attached prefixes retained. Same convention as research_historical_center_plan_v1.json.
measurement.frame: Manual horizontal envelope of verse-text letter bodies; exclude borders, notes, headings and foliation. One width per physical page.
measurement.scores: Different physical rows on same page; family and standalone endpoint counts with conservative coordinate-envelope lower/point/upper. Every page retained.
measurement.modern: Same canonical names only; existing modern ledger is contextual detector geometry, not a new common-manual comparison.
